'''Cianba''' was a [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] during the start of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] and covered the creation of the [[Outer Rim Alliance]]. She belonged to a [[Feline/Legends|felinoid]] species covered with black fur, feline eyes, long ears, whiskers, and sharp teeth. She was considered a rogue journalist for questioning the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] lack of action against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. Many [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], like those on the [[Dibrook Space Station]], listened to her [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] speeches for news about their homes and missing people.<ref name="Inv" />
